visual_review.angular: Finds angular display shapes, but first option is fragmented and one result says CondItalic despite the requested upright flag. This is a retrieval/style-constraint failure, not a recommended final selection.
visual_review.elegant: Top results are chunky, decorative or distressed and do not meet the requested elegant high-contrast serif direction. Preserved as a failure for investigation.
visual_review.humanist: The first two serif options are visually calm and related, but the shortlist has limited shape diversity. PP Pangram Sans Compact Extrabold passes a weight-400 request despite explicit Extrabold style text; Wyvern Hvy is visibly heavy. A usable pair of initial directions does not erase the style conflict.
visual_review.next: Investigate prompt/render convention and explicit style-name conflicts. Keep held-out first-pass configuration frozen; label later changes as post-first-pass iteration.
